minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, March 20th, 2024
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, March 20th, 2024.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Jenny Jolly, Edward Padgett, Bette
  Donovan, and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community Services
  Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Terry Kistler to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, February 21st, 2024 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Patricia Ruiz, from Optum. She discussed Optum as a medical
  group in Southern California providing various healthcare services.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 25 participants per week
  in February.

  Meals on Wheels: 665 meals served to La Verne recipients in the month of
  February.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through March 20th, 2024 was
  $30.05. The average attendance for February/March was 60 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $5,242.19

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for February except for Bingo. The
  senior program fee was raised to $1.00 at the beginning of the year.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Still in Spring Session.
 8. Aging Next: 9 La Verne residents were served in February.8 La Verne
  residents served at the Joslyn Center in the city of Claremont.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: City Hall offices have new paint. The back of Senior Hall has
  leaks from recent rains. May start work and could require the center to be
  closed for a week to repair the pitch roof. Siding of walls on roof being repaired.
  The community pool is closed for repairs and remodeling. The tennis courts are
  in the process of being repaired and one court will be converted to four
  Pickleball courts in May.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Tuesday, March 26th – Excursion, Warner Bros. Studio Tour & Universal City Walk,
  8:00AM-6:15PM.
  - Wednesday, April 13th – Senior Seminar, Cancer 101, Presented by
  Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  - Monday, April 8th– Movie Matinee, “Senior Moment”, 12:30PM.

11. Public Comments: George Borst announced Golf has about 25 players on their
  roster and has had a very good turnout. Bette Donovan is working on starting a
  possible Bunko Group. She has been visiting local Bunco groups to see how they
  provide events. She mentioned how the City of La Verne Community parking lot is
  sometimes full from the High School students. It has been addressed with the police
  department and has improved. Guest MaryAnn Kistler provided positive feedback
  regarding her experiences with Optum Healthcare doctors. It was mentioned there
  is a new Chief of Police, Samuel Gonzalez.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:55AM. The next meeting will be on
  Wednesday, April 17th, 2024 at 10:00AM.
